men.summary: At 2-1 with a 2-0 home mark, the Bluejays opened with double-digit wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55) before falling 89-82 at Kansas State in their only road game. With a NET of 83, an RPI of 111, and no Quadrant 1 games yet, the at-large case is still unbuilt, so their postseason outlook depends on piling up Q1 wins once Big East play begins.

women.summary: At 2-1 with a NET of 91 and an RPI of 90, the Bluejays have been better on the road (2-0, including a 73-71 win at South Dakota State for their 1-0 Quadrant 1 mark and a 66-60 win at North Dakota State) than on a neutral floor, where they fell 54-49 to South Dakota on Nov 11. With Big East play still ahead at 0-0, an at-large NCAA bid will require a strong conference run to move well past the current NET, so the postseason outlook is open but unproven.
